title: PPG-MS0 — Sidecar Bridge Architecture (slim CPS post + JSON physics constants)
description: Solves the file-too-big problem that made every prior monolithic CPS attempt unusable in Fusion 360. Introduces a sidecar bridge: a slim (≤2k LOC) post .cps that loads a JSON sidecar of physics constants (Kienzle kc1.1/mc per ISO group, Taylor C/n, surface-finish kr, chip-thinning gamma, chatter SLD lobes) at runtime. The sidecar is generated by PRISM physics engines, signed with a SHA, and embedded next to the post. Without this every machine post would re-inline the constants and either bloat the post past Fusion's parse limit or fall out of sync with src/physics/constants.ts.
rationale: The 10-post audit before precompact identified file size + constant drift as the #1 failure mode of the legacy stack: posts were either huge (300k+ LOC) and rejected by Fusion, or they froze old constants and silently drifted from src/physics/constants.ts canonical values (P=1800, M=2100, K=1100, N=700, S=2800, H=3200). Sidecar bridge solves both: post stays slim, constants stay canonical, and a SHA mismatch on load fails closed.

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Programmer at JM Die generates a Hurco V11 post for D2 die plate roughing.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms0: Post emits with kc1.1=2100 hard-coded as a literal because the engine was forked 8 months ago. src/physics/constants.ts has since been recalibrated to 2080 from JM Die outcome data, but the post never picks it up. Programmer sees stale forces, ignores the chatter overlay, and runs the part 12% over-fed.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms0: Post .cps is 1.8k LOC. On load it reads HurcoV11.physics.json (sidecar, 4 KB) which carries the live kc1.1=2080 + SHA. If SHA mismatch with PRISM canonical → post refuses to emit and tells operator to regenerate. Forces are correct, chatter overlay is meaningful.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: All 13 master posts (PPG-MS3..MS5) inherit the sidecar pattern from day one. No constant inlining anywhere in the post tree.

units.title: Define sidecar JSON schema (PostPhysicsSidecar v1)
units.scope: src/schemas/postPhysicsSidecarSchema.ts (Zod) — full canonical export: kc1.1, mc, Taylor C/n, EXTENDED_TAYLOR_EXPONENTS via accessor at constants.ts:700 (a, b for f and d) — sidecar emits via the public accessor, not the underscore-prefixed private symbol, kr surface-finish, chip-thinning gamma, chatter SLD lobes, CANONICAL_TOOL_MODULUS (deflection E), WHITE_LAYER_THRESHOLDS, full EDM_PHYSICS subtree (spark erosion, gap voltage, kerf overcut, skim Ra cascade, Klocke ra_models). SHA-256 + generated_at + source_engine_versions.

units.title: PostProcessorPipelineEngine stage 0: sidecar emit
units.scope: Hook PhysicsSidecarBuilder before existing stage 1; serialize from src/physics/constants.ts + per-machine overrides

units.title: Sidecar loader for CPS posts
units.scope: Generic CPS helper (loadPhysicsSidecar.cps.js) imported by every emitted post; SHA verify on load; fail closed on mismatch

units.title: Constant inlining hook (HARD BLOCK)
units.scope: src/hooks/noInlinePhysicsConstants.ts — scans emitted CPS for hard-coded kc1.1/Taylor C/n/Tool E modulus/EDM constants; HARD BLOCK on shop_floor tier; WARN on sim. SHA-256 verified explicitly.

completion_criteria: Every emitted post .cps is ≤2k LOC and references its sidecar by relative path
Sidecar SHA verified on load; mismatch refuses emission
noInlinePhysicsConstants hook blocks any future regression to inline values
Round-trip test covers happy path + 3 failure modes (SHA drift, missing sidecar, partial schema)
Migration doc covers retrofit path for the 138 existing PPValidator engines
